description: Rail connections in port zones in Flanders is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Jaarlijks evolutie van het aantal spooraansluitingen aan het Infrabel-netwerk in de havens in Vlaanderen: Antwerpen, Ostende, North Sea Port (ex. Gent-Zeehaven) en Zeebrugge. Een spooraansluiting maakt het mogelijk om een industrie aan te sluiten op het spoorwegnet. Deze bepaalde spoorinfrastructuur bestaat uit de verbinding en de private sporen, die alle spoorinstallaties voorbij de verbinding omvatte. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Spooraansluitingen, Goederenvervoer. The portal shows 104 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
